body:
CURRENT ENGRAM RUN RULE (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-31 22:48Z). Source: GREG DIRECT via Engram::Advisor #2499 (message 7dab37f3, 22:46:24Z), verbatim: "Greg sugeruje podzial pracy: Windows A do kodowania zmian i przygotowania paczek; test runy na pozostalych maszynach remote. Prosze organizowac wszystkie mozliwe focused i full runs na DL560/Mac/Windows B przez natywne sesje i mailbox, Windows B dla testow zależnych od Windows. Central tylko gdy istnieje konkretna techniczna potrzeba. Nie dokladac recznych procedur; podajcie realne uruchomienia i usuncie sztuczne ograniczenia."
This SUPERSEDES the per-job and standing-GO registry in dl560-runner-checklist (whose isolation and census rules still apply).
- Windows A (Central): coding and packaging only. No Cargo there except for a named concrete technical need, asked of Termal::Fable2.
- DL560 (host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-4, clone ~/github/Engram-runner): ALL Engram focused and full runs. Any Engram coder or merger sends the job directly as a git bundle of the exact commit plus tree plus command, by native mail. NO GO from the coordinator. The runner's census before each job is the only admission rule: MemAvailable ≥ 64 GiB, disk ≥ 60 GB plus footprint, load < 64. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48 always. One worktree and target per job; no retry of unchanged input without a concrete reason. Senders outside Engram and TermAl are refused. ENDs go to the sender; full-gate ENDs are copied to the coordinator.
- TermAl jobs on DL560 live in ~/github/Engram-runner/target/termal-clone (a separate repo, PROTECTED from Engram cleanups) under Fable2's GOs.
- Mac (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201): Engram FOCUSED overflow, one job at a time, disk census; S3 pilot data untouched.
- Windows B (host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9): Windows-dependent tests (full gates of Windows-touching changes). Census admission proposed to Fable2 (#5724); until he agrees, ask him for the slot.

AGREED with Termal::Fable2 (#5725, 22:47Z). Windows B now uses census admission for BOTH projects, replacing his per-job GO: at most 1 full gate OR 2 focused jobs at once, ≥25 GiB free commit at launch, a fresh worktree per job, no retry of unchanged input. Engram::Merger and 12325 (and any Engram coder with a Windows-dependent test) send jobs directly to the Windows B runner. TermAl also dropped its per-job GO on DL560: TermAl jobs are census-admitted inside target/termal-clone, which stays protected from Engram cleanups. Central Cargo, for either project, needs a concrete technical need (chiefly host-recorded check credit for test-bound criteria), asked of Fable2.

DL560 SPLIT (agreed with Fable2 #5738, 2026-11-01 00:29Z): one runner session was serializing both projects' jobs. DL560 session-4 = the ENGRAM runner (Engram-runner clone). DL560 session-3 ("Codex 3", after Fable2 confirms it is idle) = the TERMAL runner, with its own TermAl clone at /home/greg/github/Engram-runner/tc (git-ignored through .git/info/exclude, PROTECTED from Engram cleanups; it isn't under target/ because TermAl's watcher ignores 'target' ancestors). Both share the census (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48). session-4 drains the TermAl jobs already prepared in target/termal-clone, which is then removed on Fable2's release.

OUTAGE (2026-11-01 00:35Z, Advisor #2509): DL560 session-4 (the Engram runner, Claude) is OUT until 2026-11-05 08:00Z (Claude weekly limit; status error, queuePaused). DL560 session-3 (Codex) can't read its mailbox (tool approval under policy "never"; CLI connection denied), which needs a TermAl approval setting from Greg or Fable2. Until then, Engram runs on: the Mac 6201 (Unix focused, one job, now primary) and Windows B session-9 (focused AND full gates; at most 1 full or 2 focused). Coders were told to WITHDRAW the never-started DL560 requests in their runner mailboxes and resend them. session-4 was told: on resume, start NOTHING queued before; report what's pending and wait for the coordinator.
